title: VATSIM Session Time by FIR
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vatsim:session fir=* session_hours=*
| stats avg(session_hours) as avg_session_hours, count as events by fir
| sort - avg_session_hours
description: Shows average session hours by FIR for virtual ATC sessions.
value: Average session hours by FIR helps compare virtual ATC sessions across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `session_hours` on `vatsim:session` events and normalize `fir` so Splunk can summarize performance by FIR.
visualization: Bar chart of average session hours by FIR.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds the average session hours for each FIR so you can see what works best for virtual ATC sessions.
